Downloaded the PDF by opening the actual datasheet link on the JLC page. The 14-page FH CMI2012 Series approval sheet lists exact model CMI201209X5R6KT at 5.6uH, ±10%, Q 30 minimum at 4MHz, 1.00Ω maximum DCR, SRF 32MHz minimum, and rated current 15mA maximum.
